recreation_brief:
1. Canvas: set slide background to light gray (#F2F2F2) and draw a thin dark-red (#A00000) border around the entire slide edge.
2. Title: place 'Example of High Dimensional Data' centered at top (~5-20% of slide height), bold, dark red (#A00000), large sans-serif, the largest text on the slide.
3. Subtitle: place '(IRIS Dataset)' centered directly beneath the title, bold blue (#0000CC), slightly smaller than the title.
4. Slide-number badge: place a yellow (#FFEB3B) filled circle in the top-right corner containing black text '61'.
5. Left panel: draw a rectangle spanning ~12-52% of slide width and ~35-88% of slide height with a thin red (#C00000) border; it will contain the table (step 6) and the illustration (step 10).
6. Table (left half of left panel): build a 6-column x 7-row table. Column 1 = row index. Header row (columns 2-6): blue (#2E5C9E) background with white text 'Sepal length', 'Sepal width', 'Petal length', 'Petal width', 'Class label'. Data rows in black text on white: index 1 = 5.1, 3.5, 1.4, 0.2, Setosa; index 2 = 4.9, 3.0, 1.4, 0.2, Setosa; one '...' ellipsis row; index 50 = 6.4, 3.5, 4.5, 1.2, Versicolor; a second '...' ellipsis row; index 150 = 5.9, 3.0, 5.0, 1.8, Virginica.
7. Samples bracket: at the table's top-left, draw a vertical bracket spanning the data rows, labeled 'Samples (instances, observations)' in small black text.
8. Features bracket: below the table, draw a horizontal bracket spanning exactly the four measurement columns ('Sepal length' through 'Petal width'), labeled 'Features (attributes, measurements, dimensions)' in small black text.
9. Class-labels bracket: draw a bracket spanning only the 'Class label' column, labeled 'Class labels (targets)' in small black text, placed at the right end of the bracket row adjacent to the Features bracket.
10. Iris illustration (right half of left panel): draw a blue/purple (#3B2FBF) iris flower with green (#1B6E2A) stem/foliage; add label 'Petal' at the top and 'Sepal' at the bottom-right, each with a black leader line; add black double-headed measurement arrows with 'length' and 'width' labels for the petal and sepal.
11. Right panel photo: insert a photograph spanning ~60-88% of slide width and ~42-80% of slide height showing a purple (#7B5CC9) iris flower on green (#2E7D32) foliage, framed by a thin orange (#FF9800) border.
12. Photo callouts: overlay exactly 4 yellow (#FFEB3B) oval callouts with black text and leader/measurement lines on the photo: 'petal' (upper left), 'sepal' (right), 'length', 'width'.
13. Bottom banner: place a full-width strip at ~90-97% of slide height with white fill and a thin border; center the text '4 Features: Width and Length of both sepal and petal' with '4 Features:' in bold red (#C00000) and the remainder in bold blue (#0000CC).
